name: peertube-plugin-subtitle-translator-v2
description: Translate PeerTube video captions with TranslateGemma through an OpenAI-compatible chat completions API
author: Luxembourg Media & Digital Design Centre

scripts.stage: npm run build && mkdir -p .staging && rm -rf .staging/peertube-plugin-subtitle-translator-v2 .staging/*.tgz && mkdir .staging/peertube-plugin-subtitle-translator-v2 && npm pack --pack-destination .staging && tar xzf .staging/peertube-plugin-subtitle-translator-v2-*.tgz -C .staging/peertube-plugin-subtitle-translator-v2 --strip-components=1
